'''Andreas Marx''' (born 1968<ref name=":0">{{cite web |date=1 October 2024 |title=Albrecht Kossel Award for Andreas Marx |url=https://www.chemistryviews.org/albrecht-kossel-award-for-andreas-marx/ |access-date=17 November 2025 |website=ChemistryViews}}</ref>) is a German [[chemist]] and university administrator. He has been President of the [[University of Jena|Friedrich Schiller University Jena]] since 2024 and is Professor of [[Biological Chemistry]]. 

== Academic and professional background ==

Marx studied chemistry at the [[University of Freiburg|Albert Ludwig University of Freiburg]], the [[University of Sussex]], and the [[Ruhr University Bochum]]. He received his Diplom from Ruhr University Bochum in 1994.<ref name=":0" /> From 1994 to 1997 he completed his doctoral studies at the [[University of Basel]], working in the research group of [[Bernd Giese]]. He subsequently conducted postdoctoral research at [[Nagoya University]] in Japan from 1997 to 1999.<ref name=":0" />

In 1999 Marx became a group leader at the Kekulé Institute for Organic Chemistry and Biochemistry at the [[University of Bonn]], where he habilitated in 2003.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{cite web
 | title = Prof. Dr. Andreas Marx CV
 | url = https://www.chemie.uni-konstanz.de/marx/group/prof-dr-andreas-marx/cv/
 | website = University of Konstanz, Department of Chemistry
 | access-date = 17 November 2025
}}</ref> In 2004 he accepted an appointment as Professor of Organic Chemistry in the Department of Chemistry at the [[University of Konstanz]].<ref name=":0" />

== Leadership roles ==

From 2007 to 2021 Marx served as coordinator of the Graduate School of Chemical Biology at the University of Konstanz. He was Vice-Rector for Research and Young Scholars at the University of Konstanz from 2010 to 2013.<ref>{{cite web
 | title = Hochschule: Chemieprofessor Andreas Marx wird Präsident der Uni Jena
 | url = https://www.zeit.de/news/2024-04/09/chemieprofessor-andreas-marx-wird-praesident-der-uni-jena
 | website = DIE ZEIT
 | date = 9 April 2024
 | access-date = 17 November 2025
}}</ref>

== Presidency of the University of Jena ==

In April 2024 Marx was elected President of the [[Friedrich Schiller University Jena]], succeeding [[Walter Rosenthal]].<ref>{{cite web
 | title = New President of the University of Jena elected
 | url = https://www.uni-jena.de/en/242330/new-president-of-the-university-of-jena-elected
 | website = Friedrich Schiller University Jena
 | date = 9 April 2024
 | access-date = 17 November 2025
}}</ref> On 1 August 2024 he took up a professorship in Biological Chemistry at the same institution. He was formally appointed President on 2 August 2024 by the Thuringian Minister of Science, [[Wolfgang Tiefensee]].<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1">{{cite web
 | title = Tiefensee appoints new President of the University of Jena
 | url = https://www.uni-jena.de/en/262009/tiefensee-appoints-new-president-of-the-university-of-jena
 | website = Friedrich Schiller University Jena
 | date = 2 August 2024
 | access-date = 17 November 2025
}}</ref>
